descriptionMarkdown:
Ram: the driver spends an action, moves at least 20 ft straight using available vehicle movement, and chooses a target 
in the path. It makes a Dexterity save against 8 + the driver’s Dexterity modifier + Vehicles proficiency, if trained. 
Damage is 4d6 bludgeoning for a Large rammer, 6d6 for Huge or 8d6 for Gargantuan. A creature takes half on a 
successful save and moves to the nearest safe space. A vehicle that succeeds avoids the ram if it has a clear path; 
otherwise it fails. Fixed obstacles automatically fail.
On contact the rammer stops. A struck vehicle or solid obstacle deals half the rolled damage back to it. An accidental 
collision deals the full size-based damage to the moving vehicle and obstacle. Apply DT normally. A vehicle can ram 
once per round and cannot also Drive Hard. Hull damage harms occupants only if it causes a wreck.
